description: Reference packet for the optimizer pushforward interface (issue #619). The fine level is the twelve-port probability simplex, the coarse level is the six-axis probability simplex, and the refinement channel sums each antipodal port pair into its axis; the pairing is read from the hash-pinned #565 selector receipt, so the channel is A1-sourced. The verifier derives the exact sufficiency family where information projections commute with refinement for every rational coarse target, the quantitative nonclosure countermodel with exact defect 5/66 from a within-axis constraint the channel cannot express, and the four-control battery with exact rational witnesses. The verdict classifies cross-refinement optimizer compatibility as a conditional open interface: exact under compatible references and channel-expressible constraints, quantitatively false otherwise.
